g.text: Use a motor supply matched to the motor and carrier. J2 pin 1 is +VM; pin 2 is GND.

g.desc: Use a motor supply matched to the motor and carrier. J2 pin 1 is +VM; pin 2 is GND.

g.text: Share ground with the Uno. Do not power the motor from an Uno GPIO or assume

g.desc: Share ground with the Uno. Do not power the motor from an Uno GPIO or assume

g.text: its 5 V rail can supply motor current. Check stall current, decouple near the

g.desc: its 5 V rail can supply motor current. Check stall current, decouple near the

g.text: carrier, and test with the motor unloaded. This logical drawing does not show

g.desc: carrier, and test with the motor unloaded. This logical drawing does not show

g.text: internal driver circuitry or certify a carrier variant. ERC and exact-net checks

g.desc: internal driver circuitry or certify a carrier variant. ERC and exact-net checks

g.text: validate connectivity only; physical hardware is not tested.

g.desc: validate connectivity only; physical hardware is not tested.

g.text: J1 is a logical TB6612FNG carrier connector. Pins 1-9 are AIN1, AIN2, STBY,

g.desc: J1 is a logical TB6612FNG carrier connector. Pins 1-9 are AIN1, AIN2, STBY,

g.text: PWMA, VCC, VM, GND, AO1 and AO2. Confirm the actual carrier pin labels.

g.desc: PWMA, VCC, VM, GND, AO1 and AO2. Confirm the actual carrier pin labels.

g.text: Uno D2/D3 set direction, D4 enables standby, and D9/OC1A carries PWM.

g.desc: Uno D2/D3 set direction, D4 enables standby, and D9/OC1A carries PWM.
